patterns: Two cities read a reversed river as a promise of victory. Recover the omen's hidden condition and decide whether civic honor can mean a shared rescue.
A homeward crew encounters the voice of a companion it abandoned. Free a captive storm and restore a truthful story before the beacon will lead them home.
A living visitor follows an unfinished request across death's border. Face unequal judgment, choose the cost of a farewell and return without commanding the dead.

scenes:
Two Armies and One Omen|Objective: stop a premature crossing. Hold the ford or escort envoys; delay provokes the river bull
The Island's Missing Voice|Objective: identify the lost companion. Compare echoes or recover the cook's bowl; delay lets the false navigator steer
The Queue at Death's Border|Objective: hear the unfinished request. Join the humble line or ask the chorus; delay lets the royal shade erase it
Under the Scraped Decree|Objective: recover the prophecy's condition. Read the tablet or find its rubbing; delay authorizes invasion
A Storm Kept in Chains|Objective: plan a safe release. Mark the dive route or evacuate the hearths; delay wrecks another ship
What a Life Left Undone|Objective: judge the deed fairly. Present the village record or remove the ranking mask; delay favors tomb wealth
Standards in the Laurel Pass|Objective: secure a shared truce. Lower both banners or witness the envoys' pact; delay begins a duel
Descent to the Pearl Altar|Objective: return the squall to open water. Use the anchor stone or a decoy shell; delay exhausts the diver's reed
The Garden of Days|Objective: choose a voluntary farewell. Offer a memory or leave with the written request; delay draws the memory moth
Weapons into Rescue Hooks|Objective: fulfill the rescue omen. Free stranded people or reopen the nonmilitary crossing; delay raises the flood
The Companion Left Behind|Objective: acknowledge abandonment. Record the captain's admission or sing the missing verse; delay quenches the beacon
An Errand for the Living|Objective: finish the requested task. Carry the message or witness a mourner's completion; delay closes the quiet ferry
The River's Reckoning|Objective: decide the ford's future. Share repair labor or maintain a witnessed neutral passage; delay renews the muster
The Homeward Flame|Objective: open a truthful route home. Name every companion or carry their chosen story; delay leaves the crew adrift
A Return that is Not a Command|Objective: honor the dead person's choice. Accept the farewell or fulfill the living request; delay grants the royal shade another claim
A Prophecy Worth Keeping|Objective: settle the cities' legacy. Record the rescue and truce or renounce victory claims; name the next watch
Weather without a Master|Objective: leave the island safely. Free the squall or bind only a voluntary shelter pact; name who repairs the anchorage
The Road Back to Life|Objective: leave death's border with consent. Present the completed deed or witness an honest refusal; record the farewell

progressionPaths:
Ford Guardian|earn honor through rescue and restraint; gain shared watch authority and repair duties
Free Storm Herald|earn renown by ending captive weather; gain island welcome and evacuation responsibilities
Farewell Keeper|earn trust by honoring unfinished requests; gain threshold passage and witness obligations
Laurel Peacemaker|earn standing by making truce practical; gain envoys and neutral route duties
Pearl Wayfinder|earn confidence through safe descents; gain altar knowledge and crew protection duties
Living Messenger|earn remembrance by finishing requested deeds; gain mourner support and consent obligations
